defects: All three boards counted letters by code point but used UTF16 length/indexed text.
The skeleton/approach repeated the inconsistent length unit.
O(k) storage omitted materialized code-point text in the corrected approach.
rationale: Use string-iterator code points consistently, including lone surrogates; shortest/tie positions use code-point counts. Bound text/letters to50000/20000 UTF16 units and state n/m as those input lengths. All three boards materialize text points, count wanted points and join only the final best slice. Correct skeleton/approach and state O(n+m) time/storage; allow streaming O(k). Add one visible emoji and three hidden assertions:1573 small text/requirement pairs against direct substring/count enumeration, full/lone-surrogate/no-normalization/leftmost cases, and maximum Unicode/ASCII lengths. The formed-kind-counter alternative passes; the former reference passed original ASCII-only cases and now fails.

relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: Overstarting or cloning values changes real caller behavior.

defects: Input/limit bounds, callback this/arguments and result/rejection identity were unspecified.
Reference/junior array-member calls differed from senior bare calls.
The unfinished non-async starter crashed its own scratch-pad then call.
O(n) time did not separate scheduler overhead from task duration.
rationale: Keep all three valid algorithms, including the bounded batch junior; no work-conserving utilization requirement is introduced. Standardize zero-argument bare invocation. Rejection does not promise cancellation of other workers. State O(n) scheduling overhead excluding task work/waits. Make the unfinished starter async so it fails tests rather than crashing top-level. Add one visible object-identity case and three hidden assertions:36 small count/limit schedules with exact invocation shape/counts and measured virtual in-flight ceilings, undefined/Symbol/object/NaN/zero/infinity/freshness/rejection identity, and2000-task boundaries at serial/intermediate/huge limits. defects: Budget/callback/value domains and exact identity were unspecified.
Junior used chained recursive promise callbacks despite the live-state target.
The non-async unfinished starter crashed its scratch-pad then call.

Define primitive integer attempts in[-1e12,5], native-Promise zero-argument bare callbacks, no overlap, exact successful/final rejection identity (including falsy/undefined/Symbol/object), and unspecified Error message for no attempts. State O(a) scheduling/call time/O(1) live learner state excluding callback work and waits; the failed-run delay sum is100*(2**(a-1)-1). Make the unfinished starter async. Preserve original timing cases for native Run and virtual Submit. Add one visible rejection-identity case and three hidden assertions:five fully failing budgets with bounded timer tolerances and no trailing wait, negative/zero budgets and opaque successful/rejected values, and five7ms callbacks proving no overlap and timer intervals with real-scheduler tolerance.
